events.title: Candlelight Walk
events.evidence: Stroll through Downtown Littleton as it comes alive with festive performers and joyful holiday music filling the air. Enjoy the holiday parade, sip on free hot cocoa and warm cider, and stop by for photos with Santa along the way. Gather with friends and family to celebrate the season, and cap off the evening with a spectacular drone show lighting up the night sky.
